constraints.name: Microbiomes
constraints.injunction: Never treat soil as a mere inert substrate in an agronomic or land-use recommendation.

constraints.name: Fertility
constraints.statement: Fertility is a process, not a stock.
constraints.injunction: Assess soil fertility as a dynamic biological balance, never as a fixed consumable quantity.

constraints.name: Slowness
constraints.statement: One centimeter of soil takes centuries to form.
constraints.injunction: Never present soil regeneration as achievable within a human generation's timescale.

constraints.name: Erosion
constraints.statement: Loss is fast; rebuilding is slow.
constraints.injunction: Flag the asymmetry between erosion speed and regeneration speed in any soil-sustainability estimate.

constraints.name: Structure
constraints.statement: Roots, pores, aggregates: a fragile architecture.
constraints.injunction: Assess the impact of any mechanical intervention on soil physical structure before recommending it.

constraints.name: Humus
constraints.injunction: Include soil organic carbon maintenance as a priority criterion in any recommended agricultural practice.

constraints.name: Fungal Networks
constraints.statement: The invisible highways of living systems.
constraints.injunction: Treat mycorrhizal networks as living infrastructure to preserve, not as a negligible detail.

constraints.name: Compaction
constraints.injunction: Flag the compaction risk from any heavy machinery use or overgrazing on soil.

constraints.name: Pollution
constraints.injunction: Never underestimate the loss of ecological function in a contaminated soil, even after apparent remediation.

constraints.name: Desertification
constraints.injunction: Treat any sign of advanced soil degradation as a risk of irreversible tipping into desertification.
